from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InvestingCashFlowRecord(BaseModel):
    """Represents the Investing Cash Flow data point extracted from one financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as stated in the filing")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for the filing")
    line_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact header label used for the Investing Cash Flow line item, or 'Not Separately Stated' if structured differently")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash flow from investing activities. Negative values indicate net cash used.")
    amount_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the reported amount, e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    investing_cash_flow_records: list[InvestingCashFlowRecord]
